changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_photos_settings ( id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, customerId INT NOT NULL, transferPhotos BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, imagePaths VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', excludePaths VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', includeStandardPaths BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, nonImageExtensions VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', directoryStructure VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DEVICE/YEAR/MONTH/', fileNameTemplate VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'img_YEAR_MONTH_DAY_HOUR_MIN_SEC_NAME', removeOldFiles INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, deleteImagesOnDevices VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', imageLocation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, disableLocationWarning VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', addLabel BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, labelColor VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#ffffff', backgroundColor VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', transparency INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 80, labelText VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DATE TIME ADDRESS', CONSTRAINT plugin_photos_settings_pk PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT plugin_photos_settings_customer_fk FOREIGN KEY (customerId) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT plugin_photos_settings_customer_uniq UNIQUE (customerId) ) ENGINE=InnoDB;

changeSet.author: custom
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_photos_files ( id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, customerId INT NOT NULL, deviceNumber VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, serverPath VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, originalName VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, uploadTs BIGINT NOT NULL, lat DOUBLE, lon DOUBLE, address VARCHAR(1000), CONSTRAINT plugin_photos_files_pk PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT plugin_photos_files_customer_fk FOREIGN KEY (customerId) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB; CREATE INDEX plugin_photos_files_customer_device_idx ON plugin_photos_files (customerId, deviceNumber); CREATE INDEX plugin_photos_files_ts_idx ON plugin_photos_files (uploadTs);
